claims.notes: The policy excerpt explicitly states a 36‑month waiting period for pre‑existing diseases, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: Infinite Benefit adds 100 % of base sum insured at no extra cost.
claims.source_clause:
"Infinite Benefit* 100% of base sum insured added
Accumulate 100% of base sum insured year after year, infinite times, irrespective of claims made"
claims.notes: The excerpt confirms that Infinite Benefit adds 100% of the base sum insured and accumulates it year after year, but it does not explicitly state that this addition comes at no extra cost. Therefore the claim is partially supported.

claims.claim_text: Care Health has a 36‑month pre‑existing disease waiting period.
